Class DoubleCannon

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Tile
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.Cannon
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytruckerproject.model.tiles.DoubleCannon
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable, Cloneable
public class DoubleCannon extends Cannon
Represents a double cannon tile in the spaceship. Double cannons provide more firepower than single ones but only when facing forward (NORTH). The strength of the cannon depends on its direction.
